chapter: Boyhood in Webster Groves and early roadhouse work
title: B. Walker, and the player piano at a family friend's home
summary: A friend, B. Walker, came to the door saying a lady wanted to see Joe. Thomas recalls the family friend who hosted the kids to pump a player piano.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
